envelope_source: REAL clone runs captured 2026-08-03 (xd-red-1..4). NOT hand-authored — see [[stale-case-fixtures-false-green]].

SRTWT5800.note: DRIFT-SENSITIVE: quantities are live. Tester re-captures before asserting exact numbers; assert SHAPE + ordering rule, and the numbers as of the run.

render_rules.row_order: DETERMINISTIC sort — stock: quantity DESC; incoming: soonest ETA. CRM order is NOT stable between calls.
render_rules.zero_qty_rows: SHOWN (2026-08-03 parity fix) — every location the real stock answer shows. Decision (d) governs EMPTY probes (zero ROWS), not qty-0 rows.
render_rules.cap: NONE (user decision 2026-08-03) — every location / shipment renders. Hiding rows behind '…and N more' can hide the only stock reachable for that person's location.
render_rules.bullets: '- ' prefix, NEVER numbered (Q12/N1 — numbers are D3's contract with last_result_set)
render_rules.wording: always 'on hand' / 'incoming', NEVER the bare word 'stock' (Q13b)
render_rules.placement: immediately after the miss sentence, ABOVE 'Try:' (D2) and 'Related products:' (D3)
render_rules.negatives: NEVER printed. An empty probe is not evidence of absence (same empty envelope for 'nothing there' and 'read failed').
render_rules.format: CANONICAL — re-render the probe item's own fields (same as output-structurer), incl. flags. Bullets, never numbers.
